style: Tone: warm, confident, energetic, like a high-quality TV commercial. Pace: calm, clear diction, natural pauses.

lines.text: Over twelve thousand products. One hundred seventy-six brands. Three stores. And one system that connects it all.
This is PartsHub24: an online shop, an ERP and AI agents working together.
The shop carries the whole catalogue. Search understands typos and part numbers.
When a customer is not sure what they need, they ask Alex, the shop's AI assistant.
Alex searches the real catalogue, compares products and recommends what fits the car. Prices come from the system, never invented.
It calculates delivery to the nearest pickup point and adds the product to the cart in one sentence.
Alex also talks. Around the clock, in the customer's language.
Checkout takes seconds: pickup point, cash on delivery, done.
Customers track their order themselves, without calling.
In the back office the team sees everything in one place: revenue, margin, stock and today's tasks.
The new order is at the top. Shipping label, documents and status in a few clicks. Stock is updated automatically.
And the customer immediately sees that the parcel is on its way.
The strongest part: the AI analyst. Ask in plain words and get a table and a chart from live data. No developer, no waiting.
Point of sale in three stores, warehouses, suppliers, invoices, VAT and twenty-five ready reports.
PartsHub24. Shop, ERP and AI, in one system. Ready to launch.
